suite.doc: Internet breakout: a small VyOS firewall (fw-inet) is a CE of every tenant on one PE — VRF-lite, one attachment circuit per tenant, each in the tenant's VRF on the firewall too — announcing nothing but a default route; its uplink is the host's libvirt NAT network (DHCP) in its default VRF, where outbound tenant traffic is masqueraded. The default route travels as a VPNv4 route with the PE's End.DT46 SID for that tenant, so every site of every tenant reaches the internet; the firewall's stateful policy allows tenant -> internet only, so the tenants still never reach each other (the cross-tenant matrix of suite 04 stays all-fail) and nothing new comes in.
